title: Long-Relationship Reduction on Residential Natural Gas Supply Renewals
content:
**Relationship pricing.** On a Residential Natural Gas Supply renewal within its term, the long-relationship reduction depends on the calendar days to the acceptance date from the gas agreement's service start date and from the service start date of the customer's Beacon Ridge Residential Electricity Supply agreement: 0.0200 per therm when either span is 1826 or more, 0.0100 per therm when neither span reaches 1826 and either span is 1096 or more, and no reduction when both spans are below 1096. The reduction lowers the renewal rate by that amount per therm.

The records read are the service start date on the gas agreement and the service start date on the customer's Residential Electricity Supply agreement. A customer with no Residential Electricity Supply service start date has no electricity span, and the gas span alone decides.

| Gas span (days) | Electricity span (days) | Reduction per therm |
|---|---|---|
| 1826 or more | any | 0.0200 |
| any | 1826 or more | 0.0200 |
| 1096 to 1825 | below 1826 | 0.0100 |
| below 1826 | 1096 to 1825 | 0.0100 |
| below 1096 | below 1096 | none |

### Cases (hypothetical customers)

- Gas service began 400 days before acceptance; electricity service began 1830 days before: 0.0200.
- Gas 1200 days, electricity 900 days: 0.0100.
- Gas 1095 days, no electricity agreement: none.
- Gas 1096 days, no electricity agreement: 0.0100.
